sourceContext.note: The latest user-approved cowlick appearance is accepted as a useful current-angle reference. The five viewing directions have NOT yet been formally extracted and locked as independent angle masters.

currentAcceptedCharacteristics: one resembles katakana ヘ and the other the mirrored counterpart
roots are close together at the crown
each strand returns to / lands on the existing hair rather than ending in mid-air
a small triangular negative space remains between the two strands
shape is primary; source-image rough multi-line stroke style is secondary
no free reinterpretation into V, U, two floating hairs, or bifurcated single strand

angleModel.rule: Do not claim a direction master until root/peak/tip landing points and silhouette have been explicitly captured for that direction.

usageRule: Use this record as crown-shape QA context only. Never import face, body, pose, camera, or composition from cowlick references.
styleRule: Cowlick geometry comes from the cowlick master, but every visible cowlick stroke must use the same repeated-fine-stroke construction as the baseline. Apparent thickness must come from multiple nearby passes, never from a single thick brush.
